quarterly_data.quarter: Sakai Chemical Industry semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year to March 2026 (April - September 2025, semi-annual report): net sales JPY 40,353 million (-4.3% YoY), operating profit JPY 3,284 million (+25.1%); management states sales volumes of Electronic Materials, a growth business, are recovering. Electronic Materials: sales JPY 5,847 million (+13.2%), operating profit JPY 1,014 million (+51.7%). Dielectrics and dielectric materials for MLCCs: automotive demand began to recover in the latter part of the half and volumes rose YoY; AI-related demand was strong, and an improved sales mix plus price revisions since the prior second half lifted sales and profit. Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 1,400 million.
